The '''Republic Strategic Command''' was a strategic command of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]] consulted with the command regarding whether or not to enlist [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] in the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Appreciation">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|Deepest Appreciation|General A. D. Daeruun}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Strategic Command is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' by Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun in the Republic storyline. If the player sided with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[War on Iokath|events]] on [[Iokath]], the Command will be reluctant to recruit the Commander, but Daeruun will vouch for them. However, if the player sided with the Republic, the Command unanimously agreed to involve the Commander in future Republic campaigns.<ref name="Appreciation" />
